snippet.title: IVORY Offical Release Trailer
snippet.description:
TAALON INTERACTIVE MEDIA is very proud to introduce its debut game: IVORY!

IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

Check out IVORY on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879830/IVORY/
Check out our website: www.taalongames.com. 
Check out our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/TaalonInteractiveMedia
